title: Results
description: Q3 results.json — the single machine-readable record of a finished run, written by FlavorResult::results_json() (src/layer_4_computation/flavors/result.hpp) as <prefix>_results.json and returned verbatim by the Python bindings. The root is closed (additionalProperties: false), so this file is the complete list of keys a reader may encounter: a consumer no longer has to guess which of them exist, and a key added to the writer without being added here fails the regression suite. Units are declared by the file itself under "units" and are also carried in the key names; ESSE's own unit enums and array shapes are referenced by $ref wherever the two agree.

per_atom_vectors.description: One Cartesian vector per atom, in the order the input lists them.

flavor.description: Which calculation produced this record: 'self_consistent_field', 'non_self_consistent_field' or 'verification'.

converged.description: Whether the run met its convergence criterion. A non-self-consistent pass reports true, having no criterion to miss.

self_consistent_field_iterations.description: Iterations actually performed: the one it converged on, or the whole budget when it did not. Absent for a flavor that does not iterate.

timings_ms.description: Where the run spent its time, in milliseconds, plus the call counts those times divide. Absent when nothing ran.

units.description: The units every value in this file is in, by category. Declared rather than implied so a reader never has to infer them from key names.

forces.description: Not $ref'd to ESSE's force enum: that enum spells this same unit 'Ry/a.u.', and Q3 has emitted 'Ry/bohr' since the units block was introduced. Changing the spelling would move a value every existing consumer already reads.

execution.description: The parallel topology the run ended up with, and its measured footprint.

number_of_threads_per_process.description: OpenMP threads each process may use (OMP_NUM_THREADS); 1 without OpenMP. Absent from results written before it was recorded.

peak_resident_memory_bytes.description: The largest peak resident set over the ranks, not their sum: what a node has to fit is the biggest rank. Zero when no platform source could be read.

provenance.description: How this result was produced: engine build, the model/method/precision asked for, and the pseudopotential identities. Deliberately left open — it is metadata about the run rather than part of the physics record.

material.description: The structure the run used, in the engine's own Cartesian frame: ESSE lattice (vectors in angstrom) and basis (crystal coordinates; basis.constraints true where a Cartesian component may move, as mat3ra-made writes them). q3.workflows starts a relaxation from it.

hubbard_energy_ry.description: DFT+U (Dudarev) energy. Absent when no Hubbard correction is active.

dispersion_energy_ry.description: Semi-empirical dispersion correction, already inside total_energy_ry. Absent when the run asked for no dispersion scheme.

one_center_energy_ry.description: PAW one-center contribution. Absent for norm-conserving and ultrasoft datasets.

isolated_system_correction.description: The charged/isolated-cell correction, when one was applied. Each scheme's own labelled terms appear beside the fixed keys as '<label>_ry', all signed so that corrected = total + sum(terms).

total_magnetization_bohr_magneton.description: ∫(ρ↑−ρ↓) over the cell. Present only for a spin-polarized run that converged.

absolute_magnetization_bohr_magneton.description: ∫|ρ↑−ρ↓| over the cell. Reported beside the total because the total alone is zero both for a converged antiferromagnet and for one that collapsed to non-magnetic.

hubbard_occupations.description: Tr[n] per Hubbard manifold, per spin channel — the electron count the manifold's projectors see. Absent when no Hubbard correction is active.

atom_index.description: 0-based, matching orbital_labels below. The log prints it 1-based.

scf_energies_ry.description: Total energy after each completed iteration, oldest first. Populated by the verification flavor; absent elsewhere, so 'reported no trajectory' is distinguishable from 'reported a flat one'.

force_contributions_ry_per_bohr.description: The per-atom force broken down by physical mechanism ('local', 'ewald', 'nonlocal', 'core_correction', 'augmentation', 'dispersion', 'hubbard'). A total that disagrees with a reference says only that something is wrong; the term that disagrees says what.

forces_are_incomplete.description: Present only when a force term Q3 cannot yet compute was left out. The Python relaxation workflows refuse to run on a result that carries it.

stress_is_incomplete.description: Present only when a stress term was left out, or the topology skipped the stress entirely — in which case stress_kbar is a zero tensor rather than a physical result.

pressure_kbar.description: Hydrostatic pressure Tr(σ)/3, as the stress calculator computed it. Zero wherever stress_kbar is.

stress_contributions_kbar.description: The stress tensor broken down by physical mechanism, same names as the force breakdown plus 'kinetic', 'hartree' and 'exchange_correlation'.

valence_band_maximum_ry.description: The highest eigenvalue at or below fermi_energy_ry. Absent when no band lies there.

conduction_band_minimum_ry.description: The lowest eigenvalue above fermi_energy_ry. Absent when every computed band is occupied — a run asked for exactly its occupied manifold has no conduction edge.

band_gap_ry.description: conduction_band_minimum_ry − valence_band_maximum_ry, present only when both edges are. The Fermi energy is the divider, so in a metal this is the local level spacing at E_F rather than a gap.

kpoint_weights.description: Integration weight per k-point state, normalized so the sum is the spin degeneracy.

orbital_projections.description: |<phi'_i|psi_nk>|^2, indexed [k-point state][band][orbital]. Present only when a non-self-consistent run was asked for projections.

orbital_labels.description: What each orbital index of orbital_projections is, in the same order.
